items.title: Verão com El Niño: 5 dicas para preparar seu ar-condicionado
items.pt:
A previsão de um El Niño intenso e de períodos prolongados de calor no Brasil torna importante preparar o ar-condicionado para o verão. Limpar os filtros, revisar o equipamento, ajustar a temperatura e controlar o consumo de energia são medidas que ajudam a manter o conforto térmico nos dias mais quentes sem aumentar desnecessariamente a conta de luz.
Segundo Marcely Sondermann, meteorologista da Climatempo, o El Niño deve intensificar calor no verão: o fenômeno deve atingir seu pico no fim de 2

items.title: How to Follow Up When Nobody Replies: Email and LinkedIn
items.pt:
When nobody replies, wait a few business days, then send a short follow-up that adds something new and makes replying easy. Assume the person is busy, not that they are ignoring you, and plan on one to three follow-ups at most.

Following up feels awkward, which is why most people do not do it. But messages get buried, and a polite nudge is often what gets a reply. The trick is to be useful, not pushy.

This guide covers timing, the structure of a good follow-up, examples for cold email, LinkedI

items.title: world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
items.pt: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery. Here, we introduce world2vec to learn mechanistic world models without reward information directly from observations and actions. World2vec learns latent dynamics that faithfully reproduce the true system over long prediction horizons, with at least one order of magnitude fewer parameters than Dream

items.title: Difficulty Calibration Across Time for Membership Inference in Diffusion Models
items.pt: Modern diffusion models are trained on massive datasets that often include copyrighted or private images. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) address this by testing whether a given image was in a model's training set. The standard approach scores an image by its reconstruction loss and flags low-loss images as members.
